items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: I know Manny Albam said the same thing.

ctx.x: No. We called it “brute force school.” I started fixing things, as a rehearsal pianist, and then I think as you hear sounds and if you have fat ears and listen I think that’s the best teacher, in my opinion.
I know Manny Albam said the same thing.
